page.overview:
What is Gun Devil?

Contract Devil for the USA Contract Devil for Governments

Approximately 40,000 members of the National Pistol Association of USA

The の|Jū no Akuma}} is a very powerful devil who embodies the concept of guns/firearms. It serves as the secondary antagonist of the Public Safety Saga, specifically the titular main antagonist of the Gun Devil arc.

While never pictured in the manga, it has been stated that when the full form (100%) of the Gun Devil first appeared in the attacks of November 18th, it was depicted as having a full set of legs, feet, bones and flesh as well. Not much else is known about its full figure, however.

Also known as: Gun Devil fragments, Gun Devil body.
